definition: Alec Radford (born April 1993) is an American artificial intelligence researcher.
details: He worked at OpenAI from 2016 to 2024.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Alec Radford — a small key that opens a big door.
